prompt: Medium shot, eye level, from across a narrow gap: at the back corner of a small British corner shop at night, an old white chest freezer with a scuffed sliding glass lid, frost on the inside of the glass. On top of the freezer lid, side by side in the middle of the frame, sit a loaf of plain white sliced bread in a clear plastic bag and a small chocolate bar in a plain purple foil wrapper with no logo and no writing. Above the freezer, a small high frosted-glass window with a rusty security grille, dark blue-black outside. Peeling cream wall, a mop bucket in the corner, a single fluorescent tube overhead with one end blackened. Taped to the front of the freezer below the bread is a large fluorescent orange star-shaped price card handwritten in black marker reading exactly "£5". Below the chocolate bar, a smaller fluorescent orange star card handwritten in black marker reading exactly "10p". Candid snapshot on cheap 400-speed colour negative film at night, pushed: heavy visible grain, slightly soft focus, muddy blacks, sickly teal-green cast from old fluorescent tubes, faint warm sodium orange from the street. Vertical 9:16. Nobody in the shop, no people, no hands, no shadows of people. No brand names or logos anywhere; every packet in the background is blurred and unreadable. Thanks.
